rules.description: Azure Shared Access Key (Service Bus, Event Hubs, IoT Hub)
Credentials embedded in an http(s) URL
AWS Secret Access Key beside an Access Key ID
HTTP Bearer token in an Authorization header
Password passed on a command line (--password, or mysql -p'...')
Password line in a .netrc file or a vault key listing
Password written in a sentence (password is X, pw: X, パスワードは X)
Password in a JSON value whose key ends in pass, passwd, password or pwd
Redis AUTH command or redis-cli -a password
International Phone Number with a country code
Date of birth after a label (DOB, date of birth, 生年月日, 誕生日)
Member, customer or account number after a label (会員番号, customer ID, membership number, account number)
Japanese postal address: a prefecture, a municipality and a block number in sequence

rules.description: Korean postal address: a 시/도 or 구/군, then a road name (로/길) and a building number, or a 동/리 and a lot number
French postal address: a number, a street type and name, then a postal code and a town
Italian postal address: a street type and name, a civic number, then a CAP and a town
German postal address: a street and house number, then a postal code and a town
Spanish postal address: a street type and name, a number, then a postal code and a town
